COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No.28 of 2022
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Vinay Kumar, Advocate, for the 
petitioner.
Mr. Rakesh Kunwar, Additional CSC, for 
the State of Uttarakhand.
The petitioner had earlier approached the 
writ court by filing a Writ Petition being WPSS 
No.2089 of 2019, for the redressal of his 
grievances, which was disposed of by the 
coordinate Bench of this Court vide its judgment 
dated 05.08.2021, directing the respondent to 
consider the representation of the petitioner. 
Consequent thereto, the representation of the 
petitioner has been rejected by the order of the 
Chief Education Officer, Nainital, dated 
27.11.2021, and the consequential order passed
which was by the Manager, CSRT Inter College, 
Nainital on 18.12.2021.
The matter requires scrutiny. Let the counter 
affidavit be filed by the respondents/State.
Issue notices to the respondent No.4. Steps 
would be taken by the petitioner within a period of 
one week from today.
List this writ petition as soon as the counter 
affidavit is filed by the respondents. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 06.01.2022
NR/
